notablePrerequisites:
Vadrik has a power of three or greater.
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
